issue.body:
Running this test randomly times out in about 10% of all invocations. The underlying issue, however, is not a too short timeout; on my machine, a passing invocation takes about 25s whereas it still times out on my machine with timeout 300s.

The flaky timeouts can also be seen on ci, e.g., http://ci.bazel.io/job/bazel-tests/BAZEL_VERSION=latest-jdk7,PLATFORM_NAME=ubuntu_15.10-x86_64/318/console
